component.name: NoSuckShell
component.summary: Cross-platform SSH manager with split workspaces and file panes

description.p: NoSuckShell is a desktop SSH manager for engineers who maintain a lot of servers. It works with your existing OpenSSH configuration (~/.ssh/config, identity files, known_hosts) and adds a split workspace, layout profiles, encrypted backups, and a file browser that speaks SFTP.

ul.li: Tabbed and split terminal sessions with broadcast input and per-pane focus.
Layout profiles map a saved split geometry to specific hosts and sessions.
Local + remote file panes with copy/move, archive, edit, and progress dialogs.
Encrypted backup format (Argon2id + ChaCha20-Poly1305) for the host store.
Optional Proxmox VE plugin (PROXMUX) for cluster overview and consoles.
Offline license verification (Ed25519) for paid plugins; the core app is free.

description.p: Sessions and key material live locally on your device — there is no project-operated cloud. See the bundled Help and the in-app Settings for data locations and security details.

screenshot.caption: Split workspace with multiple SSH sessions
Side-by-side terminals share keystrokes via broadcast mode
Layout profiles apply saved geometries to specific hosts
Quick-connect launches an ad-hoc SSH session without a persisted host
Encrypted backup of the host store, exportable to a file
Tag and group hosts; pin favorites in the sidebar
Broadcast mode mirrors input to selected sessions
